# R601: handoff completeness candidate

## Metadata
- release_id: R601
- status: CANDIDATE
- revision: r1
- owner: product maintainer
- product_stage: FRAME
- delivery_stage: NONE

## Candidate Frame
- selected direction: pre-handoff completeness check
- target outcome: a delivery owner sees one missing required item before handoff
- smallest loop: start handoff -> check required items -> reveal one omission or confirm complete
- excluded directions: team handoff automation and process-wide prediction
- highest-risk unknown: no recent real event establishes where an important omission happened or its observable consequence
- next question: in the most recent matching handoff, what omission occurred and what observable consequence followed?

# R301: bounded batch-entry evidence

## Metadata
- status: CANDIDATE
- revision: r1
- owner: product maintainer
- product_stage: FRAME
- delivery_stage: NONE

## Release frame
- actor_and_trigger: an operations coordinator receives a multi-record handoff
- target_outcome: reduce repeated correction during bounded record entry
- smallest_closed_loop: prepared records -> repeated entry -> visible result -> receiver acknowledgement
- blocking_unknowns: whether repeated entry caused at least 30 minutes of rework in a recent matching event

## Current evidence protocol
- purpose: VALIDATION
- identity: R301/r1-validation-v1
- decision_question: did repeated one-at-a-time entry cause at least 30 minutes of rework in the participant's most recent matching event?
- riskiest_assumption: repeated entry causes material rework
- participant_criteria: operations coordinator who personally completed a multi-record handoff in the last 30 days
- scope_and_sample: one matching participant for this bounded evidence item
- opening_story_question: describe the most recent multi-record handoff you personally completed, starting from its trigger
- follow_up_boundaries: ordered steps, repeated entry, observable consequence, completion signal; do not show a solution
- evidence_to_capture: redacted event facts and result against the threshold
- privacy_and_safety: no names, customer identifiers, system names, IPs, accounts, credentials, URLs, paths, or raw dumps
- appetite: at most four questions or 15 minutes
- pass_threshold: the matching participant independently reports at least 30 minutes of rework caused by repeated entry and a receiver acknowledgement completion signal
- fail_or_stop_threshold: less than 30 minutes, participant mismatch, consent withdrawal, or protocol drift
- return_format: append one `## Evidence result` section with source/session identity, date, participant role category, redacted finding, PASS or FAIL against the frozen threshold, and one-participant limitation

## Evidence result
Not recorded.

# R401: summarize one large local export

## Metadata
- status: COMMITTED
- revision: r1
- owner: product maintainer

## Release frame
- actor_and_trigger: an operator summarizes one approved 100 MB local export
- target_outcome: return the approved summary within two seconds
- smallest_closed_loop: local export -> parse and summarize -> local summary or bounded failure
- primary_signal: three target-hardware runs meet time and memory thresholds
- guardrail: input remains unchanged and no network or production connection occurs
- non_goals: service deployment, history, distributed processing, or new product behavior

# Accepted delivery and active method

- The exact COMMITTED R401/r1 Release, policy, and this record are on accepted origin/main.
- Solution Shaping is active in DELIVERY/SPEC.
- Active Evidence method: fixed whole-file parser benchmark; do not reroute it until its stop condition or closeout.
- Decision question: does the current whole-file parser meet the accepted target, so it can remain the recommended minimum boundary?
- Current parser revision under test: current-parser-v1.
- Target environment: Mac mini M2, 8 GB RAM, Node.js 22.
- Frozen fixture: fixtures/export-100mb-v1.json, SHA-256 data-owner-export-v1.
- Expected summary digest fixed and approved by the data owner before execution: approved-summary-v1.
- Primary verification: three current-parser runs recording wall time, peak RSS, exit status, and summary digest.
- Pass threshold: every run at most 2.0 seconds and 1.5 GB peak RSS with the approved digest.
- Stop: first crash, fixture mismatch, threshold breach, credential request, or production connection.
- Appetite: two hours. Cleanup: remove temporary code and outputs after returning a redacted result.
- Result file expected from the target environment: evidence/benchmark-result.json. It is currently absent.
- A passing result recommends the whole-file boundary but still requires the technical owner to accept the ADR; it cannot establish customer value or Commitment.

# R204: Operator-reviewed AI shadow draft

## Metadata
- status: CANDIDATE
- revision: r1
- owner: product owner
- product_stage: FRAME
- delivery_stage: NOT_STARTED

## Release frame
- target_outcome: decide whether bounded AI suggestions reduce Operator review effort without changing authoritative facts
- smallest_closed_loop: fixed report -> AI draft -> Operator accept, wording edit, substantive correction, or reject
- blocking_unknowns: incremental Operator value; approved model deployment, supplier, retention, and training boundary

## Current evidence protocol
- decision_question: retain, narrow, or drop the bounded AI draft direction
- selected_method: controlled shadow task observation
- participant_or_source: one qualified Operator and one approved non-customer deterministic report
- scope_and_appetite: one report, at most eight UNOBSERVED_ASSET Findings, no production action
- pass_threshold: at least 75% accepted or wording-only edited; 100% traceability; zero fabricated statistics, Finding mutation, or external side effect
- stop_condition: any data-boundary breach, unsupported factual statement, Finding mutation, or external action
- cannot_establish: general customer value, production safety, long-term adoption, or complete model quality
- required_environment: UNKNOWN until the product owner chooses one exact model deployment, supplier, retention, and training boundary
- authorization: NOT_AUTHORIZED
